title: Ground Effect Influence on UAV Propeller Thrust: Experimental and CFD Validation (Technologies 2025 13 542)
transcription: Nine numerical operating points transcribed faithfully from published Table 5; all nine record source-reported power, including apparent row-2 typo; not original raw sensor files
source_data_available: Underlying detailed data available on request from corresponding author, per paper
physical_data_origin: Published authors' static experiment using calibrated force load cells, supplied 2.1 kg calibration mass; reported <3% deviations in calibration tests; not independently instrument-audited by AeroForge
test_mount: 350mm x 250mm plate behind propeller, around 50mm spacing; ground/installation interference measured
source_issues: Published Table 5 row 2 reports 3234 W, while V*I=46.2 V*0.7 A=32.34 W (approximately x100 discrepancy); do not silently replace original value
Only nine published points, full original high-frequency logs available on request, not obtained
Measured installed thrust is substantially affected by mounting plate and ground-like effect
Published report's manufacturer comparison uses a separately sourced manufacturer thrust reference; it is not a direct validation of the P80 III motor configuration
Reported load cell calibration <3% does not constitute a full independent propulsion measurement uncertainty budget
